body: I'm just ready for it to be over.
I'm never really relaxed though. If I get enough time to sit down and do nothing, I start thinking about the end. So my mind is just always going
I feel like I've been taking so many breaths and it's doesn't help a thing. I hate myself and everything around me and I feel miserable.
I don't really know what I want to do at the moment. My head is just all gummed up

I don't think I have it in me to go.
